powers: When you would banish a card that has the Alchemical trait for its power, you may discard it instead (☐ then you may draw a card).
You may recharge a card that has the Alchemical trait to add 1d4 and the Acid or Poison trait to a combat check by a character at your location.

You may recharge (☐ or reveal) a card to add 1d6 to your check that invokes the Acid or Poison trait (☐ or to your check to defeat a barrier); if your card has the Alchemical trait, you may add another 1d6.

roles.name: Toxicologist
powers: When you would banish a card that has the Alchemical trait for its power, you may discard it instead (☐ then you may draw a card) ( or you may search your deck for a boon that has the Alchemical trait and put it on top of your deck).
You may recharge a card that has the Alchemical trait to add 1d4 and the Acid or Poison trait to a combat check by a character at your location ( or to ignore a bane's immunities for that check).

You may recharge (☐ or reveal) a card to add 1d6 to your check that invokes the Acid or Poison ( or Cold or Electricity) trait (☐ or to your check to defeat a barrier). If your card has the Alchemical trait, you may add another 1d6.
At the start of another character's turn, you may give that character a card that has the Alchemical trait.
When you are dealt ( or a character at your location is dealt) a type of damage, you may reveal a card that has a trait matching that type to reduce that damage by 2 ( 3).

roles.name: Mad Scientist
powers: When you would banish a card that has the Alchemical trait for its power, you may discard it instead (☐ then you may draw a card).

You may recharge a card that has the Alchemical trait to add 1d4 ( 2d4) and the Acid or Poison trait to a combat check by a character at your ( or any) location. ( If the combat check is by another character, add another 1d4.)

You may recharge (☐ or reveal) a card to add 1d6 to your check that invokes the Acid or Poison trait (☐ or to your check to defeat a barrier). If your card has the Alchemical trait, you may add another 1d6.
Add 1d4 (+1) to a Craft or Disable check by another character at your location.
When you defeat a barrier that has the Lock or Trap trait, you may put it in your hand. You may banish a barrier to add your Craft skill to your check to defeat a monster.
